title: Fingerprint guest delegated tool answer is accepted but Chat resume requires an organization
surface: Package Chat in native Chrome side panel
organization_context: Fingerprint guest; no bearer, profile or selected organization. Server owns guest organization resolution.
preconditions: Exact v0.2.530 release source a44a24493eec9b32376623bdaeb25c0a13977e59 loaded in an owned fresh guest profile.
Controlled page has unpredictable heading/code/stages; resource admission and final journals are valid.
reproduction: Ask the signed-out browser assistant about the controlled current page.
Observe agent-start HTTP 200 and delegated get_page_text followed by completion and end of the opening stream.
Observe one tool_results HTTP 200 with result_accepted=true, continuation_needed=true and zero pending tools.
Observe no correlated resume request, no assistant prose and one unclassified unhandled rejection.
expected: Accepted last delegated answer opens a correlated resume stream using the guest fingerprint and server-owned guest organization, then supplies a grounded assistant answer.
actual: Run 39089963557 has one accepted result POST but resume_count=0/result_resume_verified=false; UI contains one tool-only assistant article, no prose, alert or refusal.
reproducibility: One resource-valid native occurrence; deterministic real submitToolResult to resumeInstance regression reproduces accepted result with rejected guest resume and zero stream calls.
severity: S1: core guest Chat turn cannot complete after a successful delegated tool.
priority: P1: repair before the next candidate; historical public Store behavior is not a regression comparison.
cause: Shared Chat resumeInstance used requireExecutionOrganizationId at both resume admission/body reads, unlike the opening send which uses executionOrganizationForRequest and recognizes fingerprint guests. The real accepted-result funnel reaches the local organization refusal before resume IO.
sibling_census: Opening sends already use the guest-aware resolver. Resume admission and body now share it. Signed-in organization preservation, unidentified/missing-org refusals, stream-close single-flight, model overrides, scope selection and result settlement are covered. Legacy SW STREAM_CONTINUE/page-close handoff is not the mounted package result path.
reviewer: guest_resume_peer: source A/PASS and behavior guard B/PASS; real native retest pending.
acceptance_criteria: Corrected shared Chat package is actually published and adopted in extension latest lock.
Fresh exact-artifact guest first answer, same-conversation follow-up and post-reload new conversation are grounded, with correlated delegated result/resume completion and valid resources.
Authenticated resume still sends the conversation organization; only a valid fingerprint guest omits it.
Independent native review passes before retest-pass/closed.
